source.label: SYNTH
source.note: 9 bundled synthetic stand-in tiles (no Airbus pixels): the chain runs end to end, the numbers are not measurements

input.name: synthetic_swath_3x3
notes: 9 bundled tiles stitched abutting (wp15 convention); file size = the 9 JPEGs

describe.note: no ground truth: counts and confidences only -- these are NOT accuracy metrics
no ground truth: counts and confidences only -- these are NOT accuracy metrics

perception.note: Plain YOLO letterboxes the whole 2304 x 2304 px image to the detector's 768 px input (scale 0.33), so a small ship shrinks below what the detector resolves; SAHI keeps native resolution at 16 calls instead of 1.

B0.paper: no onboard detection, transmit the full image

timing_s.decoding_note: not timed: reassembling a multi-megabyte raw image is a ground-side cost outside this demo

B1.paper: YOLO on the original image, transmit detection output

B3.paper: SAHI + YOLO + semantic policy, metadata + optional ROI

plan.label: SIM

assumptions.ground link model: cubesat_sband: 2 MHz, SNR 12 dB at zenith, modem cap 8 Mbps, coding efficiency 0.8
assumptions.routing objective: J = lam_E x E + lam_T x T, lam_T = 1/3600 per s, lam_E = 0

plan.assumption_label: ASSUMPTION: every rate and power (reports 17, 19); windows are geometry

sweep.what: hours from capture until the LAST item of the semantic packet is on the ground, for an image captured at each hour of the simulated day

assumptions.label: ASSUMPTION: no power was measured in this project (report 17)

labels.bytes: MEASURED on this image: the length of the serialized packets
labels.times: MEASURED on this machine (wall clock); a laptop, not flight hardware
labels.link: SIM: propagated orbits, geometric windows, link-budget rates
labels.energy: ESTIMATE: assumed power x measured or simulated time
labels.accuracy: none: no ground truth, so counts and confidences only
